name: Monk Healer Monk
body:
A healer monk dedicates their time and energy to healing others.

Lay on Hands (Su)

At 3rd level, a healer monk gains lay on hands as a paladin of their class level. Instead of uses per day, they expend a ki point to use this ability and they use their Wisdom modifier in place of their Charisma modifier. This ability replaces still mind, purity of body, wholeness of body and diamond body for the monk. For the unchained monk, they instead gain this ability at 4th level, replacing still mind, purity of body, and the ki powers at 8th and 12th levels.

Mercies (Su)

When gaining a bonus feat from their monk levels, a healer monk may instead choose to gain a mercy available to the paladin. This ability modifies bonus feats but does not prevent another archetype from replacing those bonus feats.
